summary: A task-scoped, versioned capability map is a sound basis for routing when it records uncertainty and is continuously checked against real outcomes.

points.text: Suitability must be conditional on task subtype, language, context length, tool set, latency, cost, privacy region, and required failure behavior; a single 'best model' field erases the variables routing research finds decisive.
Each entry should carry evidence: dataset version, prompt and tool configuration, sample size, confidence interval, observed incidents, and expiry date after provider or model changes.
Offline accuracy is insufficient. The map should include calibration, abstention, robustness to malformed input, structured-output validity, and the consequences of correlated failures in cascades.
Routing decisions and downstream review outcomes must be logged so production distribution shift can invalidate or narrow an approval instead of silently degrading quality.
